banner.preliminar: Preliminary data from Call {edital}, updated on {data}
banner.final: Final allocation for Call {edital}, updated on {data}

filtros.ajudaSemestre: Shows only who will be there in the same semester as you: map, "near me" and graph.
filtros.ajudaArea: Based on the degree program. Groups with fewer than 3 students do not appear in this filter (privacy).

painel.vazio: Click on a city to see the institutions.
painel.ocultoPrivacidade: Group with fewer than 3 students: the program is not shown.

rodape.dados: Data: public PDFs from Call 08/2026 (city and country inferred from the institution name). Map © OpenStreetMap.

raio.ajuda: Select a city on the map and choose up to how many hours.
raio.semTempos: Travel times are not yet available for this data.
raio.notaTempos: Approximate times, on a weekday. Real train/bus times come from incomplete open data and may be OVERESTIMATED; that is why we show the SHORTER of it and the estimates. 🚌 ✈ = estimated (does not check whether a direct line or flight exists).
raio.estimativas: Include estimates: 🚌 bus on short routes and ✈ flights

vizinhos.nenhuma: No city with students within this radius.
vizinhos.semTempoAjuda: Cities with students but no known travel time (lookup in progress or no data in the source). Nothing is estimated for train/bus.

grafo.corte: Connect cities up to {h} h apart
grafo.dica: Drag the cities. Lines: travel time. Dashed gray: isolated group.
grafo.semTempos: The graph needs travel times, which are not yet available for this data.

medir.marqueB: First: {a}. Now click the second city.

sobre.texto: Open source (MIT license), made to be used and modified by anyone. All data comes from public lists of the UFF call. Want to help? Contributions are welcome: code, data, translations and review of programs and cities.
